DEFECT: S-1's PLAUSIBLE SET IS UNREACHABLE. `plan: []` and `visited: []` in every configuration measured (4 placements). plausibleSet() vetoes any volume whose LKP->volume segment crosses the searcher's own cone, and the searcher is BY CONSTRUCTION looking at the LKP, whose bearing from the searcher is 0 deg. Geometry: for a searcher at distance D looking at the LKP, a point at radius r<=8 m from the LKP subtends arccos(|sin(phi/2)|) and every sampled point near the LKP end of the segment is at ~0 deg. RI-STL01 §7 S-1's headline behaviour never runs.

PROBE BUG WORTH RECORDING FOR SUCCESSORS: setEntityPos() silently ignores opts.yaw; only spawn() honours it. And queueInputs() frame numbers are RELATIVE to the current frame, not absolute.
notes_for_successor: Two probe traps that each produced a WRONG measurement in this critic's first pass and belong in AGENT-PROTOCOL.md next to setRenderRate(0): (1) setEntityPos() silently ignores opts.yaw while spawn() honours it, so every rear-arc measurement taken through setEntityPos is really taken at yaw 180 — facing the player; (2) queueInputs() frame numbers are RELATIVE to the current frame, so an absolute frame number never fires and the probe reports a clean zero. Also: the fence roster is not reachable from the harness (getCrimeState() omits it, fenceQuote throws) — real ids are in game/data/crime/fences.json, e.g. fence.lilmoth.rot-hookline.
